The HT45F5V is a specialized ASSP (Application Specific Standard Product) flash microcontroller from Holtek designed specifically for SPWM (Sinusoidal Pulse Width Modulation) inverter output-end applications

• Core & Frequency: Max frequency up to 20MHz
• Operating Voltage (VDD): 4.0V to 5.5V
• Program Memory (Flash): 4K × 16
• Data Memory (RAM): 256 × 8
• EEPROM Memory: 64 × 8
• I/O Lines: 24 bidirectional I/O lines
• Analog/Digital & PWM Peripherals:
 • 12-bit × 10 ADC
 • 12-bit × 1 SPWM output
 • AC detector
 • Over-Current Protection (OCP) and Over-Voltage Protection (OVP) functions
• Communication: 1 × UART
• Package Types: Available in 24/28-pin SSOP packages
